calculation.description: Twenty-session log-return momentum normalized by twenty-session realized volatility and lagged one completed session. Validation shows a robust negative cross-sectional relationship, so portfolio use should invert the raw signal (contrarian direction).

validation.regime_notes: Validated across the 2020-2029 synthetic cross-asset sample with all 15 instruments and 862 daily cross-sectional observations. Negative IC is intentionally captured with direction -1; recent 250-date raw IC remained negative at -0.066388 (ICIR -3.803859), supporting current contrarian interpretation. Small cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
